body.grade: This removes the grade and its classes: {{classes}}. It cannot be undone.
body.gradeEmpty: This removes the grade. It has no classes. It cannot be undone.

body.class: This removes the class. It cannot be undone.
body.template: This removes the period template. It cannot be undone.

inviteLink.title: Invite link
inviteLink.body: Share one link with all your teachers. A teacher whose email matches their record joins at once; others enter their staff ID and wait for your approval.
inviteLink.hidden: For safety the link is shown only when it is made. Make a new link to share it again; the old one stops working.
inviteLink.isOff: The invite link is off. Nobody can join with an old link.
inviteLink.shareHint: Copy it now and share it on your staff group.
inviteLink.failed: Could not change the link. Try again.

requests.title: Join requests ({{count}})
requests.body: Check that each person is the teacher they chose before you approve.

personalLink.title: Personal link for {{name}}
personalLink.body: Send this link only to {{name}}. It links the account they sign in with to this teacher, with no approval.
personalLink.expires: Works once, until {{when}}. Making a new link cancels this one.

unlink.title: Unlink {{name}}?
unlink.body: Their account loses access to this school right away. They can join again with a new link.
